sections.description: Displays upcoming scheduled WordPress posts with admin shortcode reference and editable frontend styles. Visit https://ravenhawktech.com for RavenHawkTech.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress and activate it. Open RavenHawkTech → Scheduled Posts to view the shortcode and configure frontend styles.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Removed shortcode display from plugin list.
  • Added RavenHawkTech admin grouping.
  • Added shortcode reference page.
  • Added editable style settings.
